name: todo-webapp
description: The single-page React app users sign in to and use to manage their personal todo list: add, view, edit, complete/reopen, and delete tasks, with completed tasks shown separately from active ones. Holds no task data itself — every read/write goes through todo-api. Does not implement its own auth; delegates sign-in to Thunder via OIDC + PKCE.

dependencies.name: todo-api
dependencies.description: Backend API this webapp calls for all task CRUD operations (add, list, edit, complete/reopen, delete).

dependencies.name: todo-auth
dependencies.description: Thunder-issued OIDC client used for user sign-in via SSO.
